items.title: The Venetian Macau: Crafted for Timeless Luxury
items.description: From design to delivery, Creative DBB's CEO helped shape the Garden & Penthouse interiors at The Venetian Macau — a landmark in luxury hospitality.

items.title: Designed to Feel Like the Sea Came Indoors
items.description: Rope ceilings. Warm timber. Coastal murals that move. ShrimpPot was designed to do more than serve food — it was built to transport you. Another Creative DBB fit-out, delivered in full.

items.title: From Vision to Reality: Delivering L'Odore, Riyadh
items.description: One of our turnkey projects for L'Odore, a luxury perfume boutique in Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, is a testament to what can be achieved when design, engineering, and construction work.

items.title: Flagship Perfumery Boutique
items.description: Full turnkey fit-out for the iconic British perfumery brand at Dubai Mall, featuring bespoke joinery and refined detailing.
